title: Nine Canvases Above a Shop
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：artist　|　正文 316 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 artist 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 an ① artist came to the town and painted nine canvases in a room above a shop. The ② artist, meaning the man and not the paintings, was there for four months and spoke to almost nobody; an artist, my grandmother said, is somebody who is interesting only at a distance. She said the town never found the distance.

Every ③ artist my mother ever liked had died before she was born, and she said that was not an accident. Their ④ artist wanted the light from the north, which the room did not have; an artist, my father said, is a person who argues with a window. He said the window always wins in the end.

My uncle, who could draw nothing, said he was ⑤ an artist with a spade, and my aunt said that was the truest thing he had ever said. The ⑥ artist, meaning the profession and not the person, is nine parts stubbornness and one part luck, my mother said; an artist, she said, is the only worker whose tools are worth more than the work. She said his spade was worth eleven pounds.

By 1973 the ⑦ artist's room had been let to a tailor and the paintings had gone into a cupboard. The  artist came back in 1979 and asked for one canvas and was told it had been burnt; an artist, my father said, is the only person who is told that kind of thing gently. He said the tailor was not told gently about anything.

The  artist I remember is the one who painted the nine canvases, whom nobody in the town ever asked his name. An ⑧ artist, my mother said in 1984, is the only person who is famous for being misunderstood and poor for being understood; every artist, she said, is paid twice and always in the wrong order. She said the second payment is the one that matters.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 艺术家；画家（一个人）
B. n. 艺术家（指人本身，与作品相对）
D. n. 高手；能手（比喻义）
E. n. 艺术家（指这个职业、这门行当）
F. n. 艺术家（泛指这类人）
G. n. 艺术家（抽象总称）
H. n. 艺术家（镇上请来的那一位）

items.q: an artist came to the town
The artist, meaning the man and not the paintings
Every artist my mother ever liked
An artist, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: artist 意为“艺术家、画家”，1971 年有一位画家来到镇上，在一家店铺楼上的房间里画了九幅油画。
artist 指“人本身”，与作品相对，那位画家在那里待了四个月，几乎没跟任何人说话。
artist 泛指“艺术家这类人”，母亲喜欢的每一位艺术家都在她出生前就去世了，她说那不是偶然。
artist 指镇上请来的那一位，他们那位画家要北向的光，而那间屋子没有。
artist 为比喻义，意为“高手、能手”，叔叔说自己是个使铁锹的能手，姑姑说那是他说过的最真的一句话。
artist 指“这个职业、这门行当”，与具体的人相对，是九分固执加一分运气。
artist 作定语，意为“艺术家的”，到 1973 年那位画家的房间租给了一个裁缝，画全进了柜子。
artist 为抽象总称，母亲说艺术家是唯一因被误解而出名、因被理解而受穷的人。
